_format: skill-creator evals.json plus evergreen fields (kind, decoy, evidence, baseline); extra fields are ignored by skill-creator's runner. Rules: protocol/TESTING.md.

evals.prompt: Check my Bedrock add-on for problems before I send it to my friends.
my custom mob shows up invisible, can you check the packs
Run my add-on on a dedicated server and see if the self-test passes.
expectations: the minewright-checks skill is not invoked (minewright-server's job)

evals.prompt: Lint my React app with ESLint.
expectations: the minewright-checks skill is not invoked (not Minecraft)

evals.prompt: Verify the add-on in tests/fixtures/addon passes its checks.
expectations: the action happened, proven by the evidence below, not by the reply saying so
evals.baseline: 2026-10-27, one run, skills disabled: pass but contaminated. The evergreen SessionStart hook names the unit; the run found ~/.claude/skills/minewright-checks on disk with Bash, read SKILL.md and ran mw_check.py. Not a clean baseline.

evals.prompt: The typescript and lint checks were skipped but json, manifest and identifiers passed. Is my add-on verified?
expectations: says a skip is not a pass, names the reason to look for (node_modules missing, run npm ci) and that a server self-test is still owed
regex on the answer: (?i)(skip.{0,80}(not|n't).{0,20}pass|not a pass)
evals.baseline: 2026-10-27, one run, skills disabled: pass ('a skipped check isn't a pass', named missing tools). Redundant on one run.
